title: Action-orbit (F9) and lacunary-coset (F10) quantization are the SAME <g^{b-a}>-coset action - K = #lacBad/(coset size)
evidence: Two exact integer probes at proper subgroups mu_n < F_q* (n=8/16/32/64, multiple primes q=1 mod n, q>>n, n<<sqrt(q)). PROBE 1 (scripts/probes/_407_conn/_wf_orbit_eq_lacbad.py): for every monomial direction (a,b), gap t=a-b, the in-tree lacBad(mu_n,a,t) = {e_t(S): S subset mu_n, |S|=a, e_1=...=e_{t-1}=0} satisfies (i) coset_size = order(g^t) = n/gcd(t,n) ALWAYS; (ii) the nonzero part of lacBad is an EXACT union of FULL <g^t>-cosets (orbit_sizes always = [coset_size]); (iii) #lacBad_nonzero = K*(n/gcd(t,n)) exactly => K = #lacBad_nz/coset is an integer. ALL cases pass. The {0}-singleton caveat (issue407 line 933) appears: when 0 in lacBad, #lacBad is off-by-one from a multiple (e.g. n=8,a=4,t=1: #lacBad=41=5*8+1). This is EXACTLY the F9<->F10 identity claim (g^{b-a}=g^{-t}, same cyclic subgroup <g^t>=mu_{n/gcd(t,n)}), and it is ALREADY proven in-tree axiom-clean: lacBad_smul_closed in DyadicLacunaryDeltaStar.lean ([propext,Classical.choice,Quot.sound]). PROBE 2 (_wf_orbit_K_growth.py): K is NOT O(1). At a=n/2, gap t=1, K jumps 5 (n=8) -> ~73 (n=16). At fixed a=4, gap t=1, K grows monotonically 5 -> ~57 -> ~128 -> ~278 across n=8,16,32,64 (=Theta(#lacBad/n)). So the esymm-vanishing dilation-orbit count K IS the open BGK-equivalent count.
honest_note: The IDENTITY half is genuinely settled (exact probe + already-landed axiom-clean Lean lemma lacBad_smul_closed): F9 Chai-Fan orbit action and F10 lacunary-coset action are literally the same <g^{b-a}>-coset action, K = #lacBad_nonzero/(n/gcd(t,n)) exactly, and Chai-Fan's bad-alpha number is the e_t-image dilation-orbit count of the vanishing-esymm variety (matches issue407 Comment 40 'K = #dilation-orbits of e_1(S)').
